title: Eleven Years of String
subtitle: 箱子与盒子 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 箱子与盒子（生活与学习·居家与器物）
meta: 主题语境：箱子与盒子（生活与学习·居家与器物）　|　核心词汇：box　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 box 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1945 my mother was sent to pack ① a box she could not lift, and she said the lifting was the whole of the lesson. The ② box, meaning the crate and not the contents, was sixty pounds and was carried by whoever came last; a box, she said, is the only thing in an attic that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ box in that attic had the same string, and the ④ box at the back, meaning the one the porter kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever labelled properly. A box, my grandmother said, is nine parts cardboard and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the cardboard is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ box was the whole of the move, meaning the move it carried and not the crate. The ⑥ box, meaning the move and not any of that, is the only thing in a house that everybody lifts and nobody questions; a box, he said, is either something you pack or the only word that means both a crate and a move. She said the move is the part they remember.

By 1967 the ⑦ box had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the string. The ⑧ box of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was sixty pounds of crate and eleven years of packing; a box, she said, is either the one at the back or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ box I remember is the one at the back, which was unpacked in 1973 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ box, my grandmother said in 1976, is the only thing that improves by being unpacked; every box, she said, is a move that has agreed to look like a crate. She said the move was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 箱子（指箱子本身，与里面的东西相对）
C. 固定搭配：pack a box 装箱、把东西装进箱子
D. n. 箱子（指阁楼里每一只）
E. n. 箱子（指后面那一只）
F. n. 箱子（抽象：它所承载的那次搬家）
G. n. 那次搬家（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a box she could not lift
The box, meaning the crate and not the contents
box was the whole of the move
the box had become a photograph in a report
The box of the whole thing
A box, my grandmother said in 1976

answers.why: pack a box 意为“装箱”，1945 年母亲被派去装一只她抬不动的箱子。
box 意为“箱子”，指箱子本身而不是里面的东西，重六十磅，由最后走的人搬走。
box 指阁楼里每一只箱子，每一只都是同样的绳子。
box 指后面那一只（搬运工留的那一只），是唯一有人认真贴过标签的。
box 意为“箱子”，抽象指它所承载的那次搬家，父亲说 box 就是那次搬家的全部。
box 为抽象用法，指那次搬家本身，是屋子里人人都抬、却没人质疑的东西。
box 意为“箱子、盒子”，到 1967 年这只 box 成了报告里的一张照片。
box 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是六十磅的箱子和十一年的打包。
box 意为“箱子”，我记得的是后面那一只，1973 年被打开，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
box 为抽象总称，祖母说箱子是唯一会因为被打开清空而变好的东西。
